newsitem.title: USA: Atkinson venture makes low bid on Ark. dam.
newsitem.headline: Atkinson venture makes low bid on Ark. dam.

text.p: Atkinson Monday said a venture of operating unit Atkinson Construction Co and J.A. Jones Construction Co is the apparent low bidder on a $186.1 million contract awarded by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers for a river lock and dam project in Arkansas.
An Atkinson spokesman said the bid remains subject to full review until a final contract award is made, which is expected in late July. A "notice-to-proceed" could come by late August.
The project, called the Montgomery Point Lock and Dam Project in Arkansas, is located at the White River Entrance Channel at the Mississippi River in Desha County, Ark.
